claim_scope: Portions sized from engine-reported per-answer cost, per family, with a measured fixed start and kill-culprit isolation; one PHP subject (Paid Memberships Pro) at 500 regions, 3600 s, 3 GB container. Same command as the 7.7 and 7.8 runs.
instrument_check: The first portion logged 21 answered in 187 s with a measured fixed start of 23 s; the fixed start stayed at 22-24 s for all 25 portions. The 7.8 constant assumed 70 s.
reading: Completion rose from 131-153 to 281 of 406 at the same budget. The 7.8 loss was a sizer death spiral (budget stuck at 3 sink visits because portions under an assumed 70 s start read as uninformative), and measuring the fixed start and per-family rates removed it. No portion was killed, so the gain is attributable to sizing; the culprit-isolation path is unit-tested only.
limits: One subject, one language, one budget.
